title: Morphisms of schemes descend along an fpqc covering $\{X\to S\}$ (Stacks 02W0)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] such that the one-member family $\{f:X\to S\}$ is an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Put $X_2=X\times_SX$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]) with projections $\mathrm{pr}_0,\mathrm{pr}_1:X_2\to X$. For a scheme $U$ with a morphism $U\to S$ write $U_X=U\times_SX$, a scheme over $X$ by the second projection, and let $\mathrm{can}_U:\mathrm{pr}_0^*U_X=U_X\times_{X,\mathrm{pr}_0}X_2\to U_X\times_{X,\mathrm{pr}_1}X_2=\mathrm{pr}_1^*U_X$ be the isomorphism of schemes over $X_2$ obtained by composing the canonical isomorphisms of both sides with $U\times_SX_2$ (they exist since $f\circ\mathrm{pr}_0=f\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$). For a morphism $\alpha:U\to W$ of schemes over $S$ write $\alpha_X=\alpha\times_S\mathrm{id}_X:U_X\to W_X$. Then for any two schemes $U,W$ over $S$ the map $\alpha\mapsto\alpha_X$ is a bijection from the set of morphisms $U\to W$ over $S$ onto the set of morphisms $\beta:U_X\to W_X$ over $X$ satisfying $\mathrm{can}_W\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\beta=\mathrm{pr}_1^*\beta\circ\mathrm{can}_U$ (where $\mathrm{pr}_k^*\beta=\beta\times_{X,\mathrm{pr}_k}\mathrm{id}_{X_2}$).

proof.text: Let $q:U_X=U\times_SX\to U$ be the first projection. Apply [lem-galois-fpqc-covering-base-change] to the one-member fpqc covering $\{f:X\to S\}$ and the structure map $U\to S$. Thus $\{q\}$ is an fpqc covering of $U$. Its double overlap is canonically $U_X\times_UU_X\cong U\times_S(X\times_SX)=U\times_SX_2$ by the universal property of [def-pc-fibre-product]; the two projections to $U_X$ correspond to the pullbacks along $\mathrm{pr}_0,\mathrm{pr}_1:X_2\to X$.

Take a $\beta:U_X\to W_X$ over $X$ satisfying the displayed datum equation, and put $\gamma:U_X\xrightarrow{\beta}W_X\to W$. Under the overlap identification of Step 1, each $\mathrm{can}$ is the identity on the $U$ or $W$ component while changing the chosen projection to $X$. Compose $\mathrm{can}_W\circ\mathrm{pr}_0^*\beta=\mathrm{pr}_1^*\beta\circ\mathrm{can}_U$ with the projection to $W$: this gives $\gamma\circ r_0=\gamma\circ r_1$ as morphisms $U_X\times_UU_X\to W$, where $r_0,r_1$ are the two projections. This is equality of morphisms, not only of their maps on points.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent] to the fpqc covering $\{q:U_X\to U\}$ of Step 1, with target scheme $W$ and compatible morphism $\gamma$ of Step 2. It gives a unique scheme morphism $\alpha:U\to W$ such that $\alpha\circ q=\gamma$.

The morphism $\alpha$ is over $S$. Indeed, writing $p_U:U\to S$ and $p_W:W\to S$, the maps $p_W\circ\alpha$ and $p_U$ have equal composites with $q$: $p_W\circ\alpha\circ q=p_W\circ\gamma=f\circ(U_X\to X)=p_U\circ q$, because $\beta$ is over $X$ and $U_X$ is the fibre product. Uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent], applied to the same fpqc cover with target $S$, gives $p_W\circ\alpha=p_U$.

Since $\alpha$ is over $S$, its base change $\alpha_X$ has projections to $W$ and $X$ equal to $\alpha\circ q=\gamma$ and $U_X\xrightarrow{\beta}W_X\to X=U_X\to X$, respectively. The universal property of $W_X=W\times_SX$ in [def-pc-fibre-product] therefore gives $\alpha_X=\beta$. Conversely, every $S$-morphism $\alpha$ has datum-compatible base change: on $U\times_SX_2$ both sides of the datum equation have the same projections to $W$ (both $\alpha$ on the $U$ component) and to $X_2$ (the identity), hence agree by the fibre-product universal property. If $\alpha_X=\alpha'_X$, their composites to $W$ give $\alpha\circ q=\alpha'\circ q$; uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent] for the cover $\{q\}$ gives $\alpha=\alpha'$. This proves the claimed bijection.

The five steps pull the cover back to U, translate compatibility with canonical data into an equality over the double overlap, descend the W-valued map, establish it is over S by uniqueness of descent to S, and prove base-change reconstruction plus injectivity using the fibre-product universal property. lean.statement: theorem fpqc_morphisms_descend (f : X ⟶ S) (hfpqc : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S) (pU : U ⟶ S) (pW : W ⟶ S) : Function.Bijective (fun (α : {α : U ⟶ W // α ≫ pW = pU}) => ⟨baseChangeMap pU pW f α α.property.symm, baseChangeMap_compatible pU pW f α α.property.symm⟩ : {α : U ⟶ W // α ≫ pW = pU} → {β : pullback pU f ⟶ pullback pW f // ∃ hβ : β ≫ pullback.snd pW f = pullback.snd pU f, pullback.map (pullback.snd pU f) (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.snd pW f) (pullback.fst f f) β (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simpa using hβ.symm) (by simp) ≫ (canonicalDescentIso pW f).hom = (canonicalDescentIso pU f).hom ≫ pullback.map (pullback.snd pU f) (pullback.snd f f) (pullback.snd pW f) (pullback.snd f f) β (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simpa using hβ.symm) (by simp)})
